about: v0.6 verse echoes (OWNER: v0.6 WP-C): a verse heard again elsewhere, or a shared pattern. {"echo": id} in a Kathā block sets the flag echo.<id> (with a toast); the verse book then shows the echo title line under each of its verses. title: a sa-ui key (sa-ui-v06-c.json). Format: types.ts VerseEcho.

echoes.title: v06c.echo.uttishtha
echoes.source: Bāla 1.23.2 pāda 3 उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल (Viśvāmitra wakes Rāma) and Kiṣkindhā 4.66.36 pāda 1 उत्तिष्ठ हरिशार्दूल (Jāmbavān rouses Hanumān): the same call. Noticed at the launch from Mahendra (ch5.leap_start) if 4.66.36 was heard.

echoes.title: v06c.echo.kausalya
echoes.source: Bāla 1.23.2 and Sundara 5.64.28 open with the same pāda, कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम: Viśvāmitra at Rāma's first dawn, Sugrīva at the news that Sītā is found. Noticed when 5.64.28 is heard (ch5.sita).

echoes.title: v06c.echo.paduke
echoes.source: Ayodhyā 2.112.21: Bharata asks Rāma to step into the sandals that will keep the kingdom; Yuddha 6.127.52–54: Bharata puts the sandals back on Rāma's feet and returns the kingdom he kept. Noticed at the return (ch6.ravana) if 2.112.21 was heard.

echoes.title: v06c.echo.counsellors
echoes.source: Araṇya 3.37.2 (Mārīca) and Yuddha 6.16.21cd–22ab (Vibhīṣaṇa, valmikiramayan.net; CE 6.10.16): सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन्… the same couplet but for one particle (Araṇya च पथ्यस्य, Yuddha तु पथ्यस्य). Hidden: found at Vibhīṣaṇa's arrival (ch6.vibhishana_refuge).
